latest_release.name: tools/dubbogo-cli/v1.0.1
latest_release.body:
## dubbogo-cli v1.0.1

Command-line helper for scaffolding projects and managing the Apache dubbo-go toolchain.

## What's Changed
* fix: restore generated-project go.sum files by @AlexStocks in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3589
* fix: update dubbogo CLI templates for Dubbo-Go 3.3 by @AlexStocks in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3587
* update tools and companion-tool integration by @Alanxtl in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3585
* chore: modernize CLI code style by @Alanxtl in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3471
* fix: generate dependency locks for CLI scaffolds by @AlexStocks in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3483
* fix: remove viper from dubbogo-cli by @nagisa-kunhah in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3323
* refactor: migrate the hystrix filter from the main repository by @zbchi in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3253
* refactor: remove config package dependencies from the application generator by @zbchi in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3239
* refactor: remove config package dependencies from the sample generator by @CAICAIIs in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3218
* perf: precompile regular expressions by @zbchi in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/3067
* fix and update dubbogo-cli dependencies and tests by @Alanxtl in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/2932
* chore: upgrade the dubbo-go CLI version by @marsevilspirit in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/2987
* fix: improve ZooKeeper URL parsing and error handling in dubbogo-cli by @Nexusrex18 in https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/pull/2795

**Full Changelog**: 
https://github.com/apache/dubbo-go/compare/53d81d17...48d6e696
